lines.text: Ezekiel sees the likeness of a sapphire throne, and the LORD tells the man in linen to take burning coals.
The man in linen goes in while the cherubim stand on the north side of the temple.
One of the cherubim puts fire from among them into the hands of the man in linen.
Ezekiel sees four wheels beside the cherubim, and the wheels gleam like polished bronze.
The glory of the LORD moves from the threshold, and the cherubim stop at the entrance of the east gate.
